author: Baoqiang Chen

steps.title: Seed HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells at 5 × 10⁶ cells per dish one day before labeling.

steps.title: Pulse‑label cells with 4sU
steps.instruction: Add 500 µM 4‑thiouridine (4sU) to the culture medium (protected from light) and incubate for the desired time (30 min, 1 h, or 2 h). For inhibitor experiments, simultaneously add STM2457 to 20 µM or puromycin to 1 µg/mL during a 2 h 4sU pulse.

steps.title: Pre‑treat with cycloheximide
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with 200 µg/mL cycloheximide (CHX) for 10 min at 37 °C to halt translation.

steps.title: Prepare DEPC‑treated water
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL DEPC to 1 L deionized water, mix thoroughly, incubate at room temperature for 12 h, then autoclave.

steps.title: Make 60 % sucrose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 60 g sucrose in deionized water and bring the volume to 100 mL. Add 100 µL DEPC, incubate 12 h at room temperature, then autoclave.

steps.title: Prepare 10× salt solution
steps.instruction: Combine 200 mM HEPES‑KOH (pH 7.5), 1 M KCl, 50 mM MgCl₂, and DEPC‑treated water to obtain the 10× stock.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 1× salt solution, 2 % Triton X‑100, 1× protease inhibitor cocktail, 200 µg/mL CHX, 1 mM DTT, and 40 U/mL RNase inhibitor (Promega N2515).

steps.title: Prepare sucrose gradient buffers
steps.instruction: For 10 % gradient buffer: add 6.64 mL 60 % sucrose solution, 4 mL 10× salt solution, protease inhibitors (1×), 200 µg/mL CHX, 1 mM DTT, and 4 U/mL RNase inhibitor to DEPC‑treated water to a final volume of 40 mL. For 45 % gradient buffer: add 30 mL 60 % sucrose solution, 4 mL 10× salt solution, the same additives, and bring to 40 mL total.

steps.title: Wash cells with ice‑cold DPBS
steps.instruction: Place dishes on ice, aspirate medium, and wash cells with ice‑cold DPBS containing 200 µM CHX.

steps.title: Lyse cells and clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL lysis buffer directly to each dish, scrape cells, collect lysate, and centrifuge at 20,000 g for 10 min at 4 °C. (For suspension cells: omit DPBS wash, harvest by pipetting, and centrifuge at 300 g for 3 min at 4 °C.)

steps.title: Prepare linear sucrose gradients
steps.instruction: Using a Biocomp Gradient Master, program a linear 10 %–45 % sucrose gradient for a SW41Ti rotor.

steps.title: Load samples and ultracentrifuge
steps.instruction: Load 400 µL clarified lysate onto each gradient and centrifuge at 36,000 rpm for 1.5 h at 4 °C in a Beckman Optima L8‑80XP ultracentrifuge (SW41Ti rotor).

steps.title: Fractionate gradients and pool
steps.instruction: Fractionate each gradient into 12 equal fractions. Combine fractions representing free RNA, 40S/60S subunits, 80S monosomes, and polysomes into four pooled fractions. Freeze pooled fractions at –80 °C (store ≤ 1 week).

steps.title: Add spike‑in and extract RNA
steps.instruction: To each 1 mL pooled fraction add either 1 µg yeast total mRNA (endogenous spike‑in) or 1 ng IVT mRNA (library spike‑in). Add 750 µL TRIzol, vortex 15 s, incubate 5 min at room temperature, add 200 µL chloroform, vortex 15 s, incubate 2–3 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Transfer the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Precipitate and wash RNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL) and an equal volume of isopropanol, mix, and centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. Wash the pellet with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, air‑dry 3–5 min, and resuspend in 20–50 µL RNase‑free water. Determine concentration and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thiol‑modify RNA with IAA
steps.instruction: In a 50 µL reaction combine 0.5–20 µg RNA, 5 µL DPBS, 5 µL IAA (100 mM), 25 µL DMSO, and RNase‑free water to 50 µL. Incubate 50 °C for 15 min, then add 1 µL 1 M DTT to stop.

steps.title: Precipitate modified RNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL glycogen (20 mg/mL), 5 µL 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2), and 125 µL 100 % ethanol, vortex, incubate –80 °C for 30 min, centrifuge 16,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. Wash twice with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, air‑dry 3–5 min, and resuspend in 5–10 µL nuclease‑free water. Store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Enrich mRNA with beads
steps.instruction: Perform mRNA enrichment on the thiol‑modified RNA using Vazyme mRNA beads according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Reverse transcribe mRNA
steps.instruction: Mix purified mRNA with 1 µL poly‑dTVN primer (10 µM) and nuclease‑free water to 5 µL. Heat 70 °C for 5 min, chill on ice. Add 1 µL 10× M‑MuLV RT buffer (NEB), 1 µL TSO (1 µM), 0.5 µL M‑MuLV RT (20 U/µL), 0.5 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 0.1 µL RNasin (40 U/µL), and 1.9 µL water. Incubate 42 °C for 90 min, then 85 °C for 5 min, hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA by PCR
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL reverse transcription mix with 5 µL 5× KAPA HiFi Buffer (Roche), 0.5 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart polymerase, 0.25 µL ISPCR primer (10 µM), 0.75 µL dNTPs (10 mM), and 8.5 µL nuclease‑free water. PCR: 98 °C 45 s; 10 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 67 °C 15 s, 72 °C 3 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min.

steps.title: Purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified cDNA using VAHTS DNA Clean Beads (Vazyme) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Tagment cDNA with Tn5
steps.instruction: Prepare 2.5 µL tagmentation buffer (40 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 40 mM MgCl₂), 1.25 µL purified cDNA (1–50 ng/µL), and 1.25 µL Tn5 working solution. Incubate 55 °C for 10 min, then add 1.25 µL 0.2 % SDS and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Amplify tagmented cDNA
steps.instruction: Set up a 15 µL PCR: 5 µL tagmentation product, 1.2 µL 5× KAPA Buffer, 0.75 µL 100 % DMSO, 1.25 µL each i5 and i7 adapters (10 µM), 0.45 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 0.3 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart polymerase, 4.8 µL nuclease‑free water. Thermocycler: 72 °C 3 min gap fill; 95 °C 30 s; 12 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 58 °C 15 s, 72 °C 30 s; final 72 °C 3 min.

steps.title: Size‑select library fragments
steps.instruction: Run the PCR product on a 3 % agarose gel, visualize, and excise DNA fragments between 250 bp and 400 bp. Purify the gel slice using the Magen Gel Extraction Kit (Magen Biotechnology) per the kit protocol.

steps.title: Quantify and sequence library
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified library with a Qubit fluorometer and submit for NovaSeq sequencing (150 bp paired‑end reads).

steps.title: Differentiate THP‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Culture THP‑1 cells to the appropriate density, add phorbol 12‑myristate 13‑acetate (PMA) to 5 ng/mL, and incubate 24 h. Replace with fresh PMA‑free medium and incubate an additional 72 h to obtain resting macrophage‑like cells.

steps.title: Activate THP‑1 macrophages
steps.instruction: Add lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to the rested THP‑1 macrophages at 1 µg/mL and incubate as required for downstream assays.

steps.title: Prepare protein lysates for proteomics
steps.instruction: Collect 1 × 10⁶ cells, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, and repeat DPBS wash three times. Quantify protein by BCA assay. Aliquot 20 µg protein, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 15 µL DPBS and 5 µL 5× SDS loading buffer, vortex, heat 100 °C 10 min, then place on ice.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and excise bands
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 % SDS‑PAGE gel, load 20 µL of each sample, and run for 30 min. Stain, excise all protein bands, and proceed to in‑gel trypsin digestion.

steps.title: In‑gel digestion and MS analysis
steps.instruction: Digest the excised gel pieces with trypsin, extract peptides, and analyze on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer. Determine protein abundances from the MS data.
